Destinations / Coorg & Chikmagalur

Coorg & Chikmagalur

Coffee estates, waterfalls and rainforest roads

Best time: October – April. Easy weekend from Bengaluru, cool weather and plantation stays kids enjoy.

Highlights

  • Coffee plantation walks
  • Abbey Falls
  • Dubare elephant camp (observation only)
  • Mullayanagiri peak

Suggested road trips

Bengaluru → Coorg → Chikmagalur

5 days · about 620 km. Coffee country loop with waterfalls and a monastery stop at Bylakuppe.

  1. Bengaluru → Madikeri (265 km, about 6 h): Stop at the Bylakuppe monasteries.
  2. Madikeri → Abbey Falls & Raja’s Seat (30 km, about 1.5 h)
  3. Madikeri → Chikmagalur (180 km, about 5 h)
  4. Chikmagalur → Mullayanagiri (60 km, about 3 h): Park big vans lower down.
  5. Chikmagalur → Bengaluru (245 km, about 5.5 h)

Before you go

Madikeri about 1,100 m; Mullayanagiri about 1,900 m.

Pumps in Madikeri, Kushalnagar and Chikmagalur.

Narrow estate roads; the road up to Mullayanagiri is too tight for big vans at the top. Heavy monsoon June–September.
